title: 第一卷 第5章 都杀，一个不留！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

平日里嚣张跋扈惯了，突然挨了这么一顿打，搁谁心里都会有些不爽。

喝了酒的陈三，肯定也不惯着自己的这个泼皮兄弟。

“放你娘的狗屁，你怎么不去试一试？那小子跟变了个人一样，下手又快又狠，要是之前的那个秦云，我绝对把他打得找不着北。”

争吵声也让断了鼻子的刘二赖有些烦躁，直接就开口骂道：“都他妈少说两句，你们有我挨揍挨的厉害吗？等我养好伤，非得让我姐夫把那小子整死在散关不成。”

就在这些家伙争论不休的时候，东厢房的门也被推开。

随即就是一股冷风灌了进来。

直接就让这些醉酒的家伙清醒了几分，特别是刘二赖心中掠过了一抹不安，当即站起身来。

朝着推门的方向来了一句：“谁。”

但回答他的只有一道刀光。

秦云没有半点要跟他们废话的意思，直接蹬步进屋。

速度快到让房间里的所有人都没反应过来，就直接抹了离门口最近的那个泼皮的喉咙。

一刀封喉。

从喉咙里喷出来的鲜血，直接让坐在他对面的陈三糊了一脸。

被抹喉的泼皮直接无力地栽倒在地。

陈三被喷了一脸鲜血，这时也反应了过来。

“妈的，是秦云！”

他用着还能动的左手，从桌上掏起了一把剔骨刀，直接朝着冲进来的秦云砍了过去。

四个人之中最能打的就是这个叫陈三的泼皮，秦云也知道这一点，所以，先做掉离门口最近的，随后便将所有的注意力都集中在了他的身上。

先是侧开身子，躲过了他砍过来的剔骨刀，随即左手伸出，抓住他持刀的手腕，猛地往桌子上一按。

左手的弯刀没有任何犹豫，直接就顺势上挑。

直接割破了他的喉咙，没有半点犹豫和手下留情。

从他暴起到毙命，前后只不过是一个呼吸的时间。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

He was used to being arrogant and domineering, but suddenly receiving such a beating would make anyone feel a little unhappy.

Chen San, who was drunk, must not be used to his naughty brother.

"Fuck your mother, why don't you give it a try? That kid is like a different person. He strikes fast and hard. If it were the same Qin Yun from before, I would definitely beat him to the point where he couldn't find anything to do."

The quarrel also made Liu Erlai, who had a broken nose, a little irritated, and he started to curse: "Don't say a damn thing, are you beaten as hard as me? When I recover from my injuries, I have to let my brother-in-law beat that kid to death in Sanguan."

While these guys were arguing, the door to the east wing was pushed open.

Immediately, a cold wind rushed in.

It immediately made these drunk guys sober up, especially Liu Erlai, who felt uneasy and stood up immediately.

He said in the direction of pushing the door: "Who?"

But the only answer he received was a flash of a sword.

Qin Yun had no intention of talking nonsense to them and stepped directly into the house.

The speed was so fast that everyone in the room didn't react, and he wiped the throat of the rogue closest to the door.

Seal the throat with a knife.

The blood spurting out from his throat directly confused Chen San, who was sitting opposite him.

The rogue whose throat was wiped fell to the ground helplessly.

Chen San was sprayed with blood on his face, and he also reacted at this time.

"Damn it, it's Qin Yun!"

With his left hand that could still move, he took out a boning knife from the table and slashed directly at Qin Yun who rushed in.

The most capable of beating among the four was the rogue named Chen San. Qin Yun also knew this, so he killed the one closest to the door first, and then focused all his attention on him.

First, he turned sideways to avoid the boning knife he was slashing at, then stretched out his left hand, grabbed his knife-holding wrist, and slammed it down on the table.

The scimitar in his left hand was raised without any hesitation.

He cut his throat directly without any hesitation or mercy.

From his violent outburst to his death, it only took one breath.
